full_page.content:
c. 1897 to 1904
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Small Book of the Rule and Testament of St. Francis with writing of Fr. Solanus Casey on three pages:
Pg. 1. 1897 ad u. Fr. S. Casey
Pg. 2. I labor for Eternity, not $100 per day or $1000.00 a month.
Pg. 3. Memorable Days (these entries c. 1901) Jan. 13th 1897 - dark indeed Jan 14th 1897 Invested (after a day of anxiety) Deo Gratias. July 21st 1898 1st Profession.
July 21st 1901
Solemn Profession
(following entries c. 1904)
July 25th 1902 Minors - Archb. Katzer.
Dec. 8th 1903 S. Deac. B. Messmer
Mar. 20th 1904 Deacon
July 24th Presbiter =
S. D. and Deacon in S.F. Seminary
1st Eoly Mass July 31st 1904
(later entries)
M. & E. Ordained in St. Paul 9/6/1911
P. & M. Jubileum " Seattle 6/10/1913 32 yrs. later First Mass of Nephew in Seattle J. McC. S.J. Religious G. Jubilee Jan. 14 '47
